title: Exercise the source-owner version warning label through the production seam
outcome: Metadata-window coverage observes the operation label chosen by the production source-owner path, and distinguishes fixture-only warning/elapsed accounting from production behavior.
acceptance: A behavioral control reaches the operation label and warning owner actually used by engram_source_owner_run for --version, with scaled/scripted time and no real-minute wait or alternate process runner.

Fixture-only warning and elapsed-sum assertions are removed, accurately described or backed by the actual production seam; the55s-success/70s-refusal deadline discrimination, no-resend/evaluator/identity controls remain.
